instruction: Look at drill_plate.step in NX CAM. Recognize the four marked hole locations on drill_plate.step. Use T1 for Center Drill or Spot Drill, and use T2 for Drill. All holes must break through the bottom by 1 mm. Use T1 at S8000 rpm and F250 mm/min, and T2 at S5000 rpm and F180 mm/min. Tool definitions: T1 is a 90 degree spot drill at S8000 rpm and F250 mm/min; T2 is a 5 mm drill at S5000 rpm and F180 mm/min. Write the required output file(s) using exactly these Desktop path(s): C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-3.nc.
